newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: GP Batteries to convert listing to S$.
newsitem.headline: GP Batteries to convert listing to S$.

text.p: GP Batteries said on Wednesday it had received approval from the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) to convert its listing to Singapore dollars from U.S. dollars.

GP Batteries said in a statement the approval came after an application by the company under new criteria allowing foreign companies to list and trade their shares on the SES in Singapore dollars if they have significant operations there.
GP Batteries has its operational headquarters in Singapore and has a senior management team in the country, it said.

The SES approval was subject to the condition that should the proportion of its expenses attributable to its Singapore operations fall below 35 percent, the company would not be able to issue new shares or bonds in Singapore in Singapore dollars until the position was rectified.
It said it would make a further announcement giving the effective date of conversion at a later date.
